paper_title: New constraints on light Axion-Like Particles using Chandra Transmission Grating Spectroscopy of the powerful cluster-hosted quasar H1821+643
notes: Headline photon-ALP coupling limit from H1821+643 Chandra HETG/LETG spectral-distortion search, assuming thermal-to-magnetic pressure ratio beta=100. Curve traced from the paper's Figure 5 (e-print file images/fig4_myPaper.pdf; note internal filename fig4 = paper Fig.5), the 'This work, 99.7% CL' magenta line (combined HETG+LETG). This is the paper's main result; the 95.5% CL curve lies slightly below. Flat exclusion at g_agamma > 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a < ~1e-12 eV (matches abstract), with genuine oscillatory structure (5e-13 to 8e-13) between ~1e-13 and ~3e-12 eV, then a steep rise for m_a > ~5e-12 eV. Last point (1.57e-11 eV, 1.58e-11) is clipped at the plot top frame; the real curve continues above 1e-11 GeV^-1. Axis calibration from vector gridlines: x decades at fig-x 82.51..378.32 (10^-19..10^-11), y decades at fig-y 175.1 (10^-12) and 46.2 (10^-11). Not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence. Curve extends left to the plotted 10^-19 eV; text notes the flat limit holds down to much lower masses (log(m_a/eV) as low as -30).
